text:
Maya (CSM): FYI Fenwick reported intermittent failures during onboarding tests this morning. can we get a short breakdown (5xx / timeouts / rate_limit) and top failing endpoints for the last 12h?
eng-alert-bot: Automated alert: account:fenwick spike - error_rate +180% over 1h.
Jordan (SRE): quick pull: 5xx=95, timeouts=230, rate_limit=12 over 12h. Top failing endpoints: /v1/chat/respond, /v1/complete, /v1/embeddings/batch.
Alex (Support): customer says failures concentrated during a bulk embeddings job (2M tokens) started at 07:40 UTC. they used parallel workers.
Priya (Fenwick): yes - we kicked off a large ingest to test search relevancy. failures started ~10m in. screenshots DM'd.
Maya (CSM): thanks. renewal is next quarter; want to avoid bad demo. labeling as high-priority for triage.
Jordan (SRE): quick analysis: the embeddings/batch route shows long tail latency and growing queue depth on quantized serving nodes; concurrent worker pattern caused request storms and some nodes hit memory pressure -> 502/504. the chat/respond 5xxs correlate with the same node pool due to shared resources.
Alex (Support): actionable asks for customer?
Jordan (SRE): ask them to throttle parallelism to 4 workers and switch embeddings/batch size to 256 items per req. recommend retry with jitter for 502/504 and exponential backoff. also suggest switching to the dedicated embeddings route if they need higher throughput.
Priya (Fenwick): can we get a quick config snippet?
Jordan (SRE): posted suggestion:
```
// client-side: throttle example
const MAX_CONCURRENCY = 4;
for (const chunk of chunks(embeddingsList, 256)) {
  await pLimit(MAX_CONCURRENCY)(() => callEmbeddings(chunk));
}
// on 502/504: backoff with jitter
```
Maya (CSM): any immediate mitigations we can apply server-side while they re-run?
Jordan (SRE): temp mitigations done: 1) raised per-account rate_limit soft cap from 60->120 for fenwick to reduce 429s, 2) enabled request-level KV prefix caching for chat/respond, 3) temporarily routed fenwick to pool:emb-stable-02. expect timeouts to fall in 20-40m.
eng-alert-bot: Routing rule applied: account:fenwick -> pool:emb-stable-02 (id: rr-902)
Jordan (SRE): monitoring - initial telemetry shows timeouts down ~55% and 5xx down ~70% after route change + cache. continuing to watch.
Alex (Support): noted. I'll update the support ticket and add the suggested client snippet. also logging a spend note - retries bumped their estimated spend ~15% during the spike.
Maya (CSM): scheduling a 30m enablement call with Priya to walk throttling and embedding best practices. putting a renewal-watch flag in CRM until we see stable metrics for 48h.
Priya (Fenwick): thanks team. running the reduced concurrency job now; will report back in 30m.
Jordan (SRE): follow-up - please send us a sample request id if you still see failures; we can pull full traces.
Priya (Fenwick): test finished: no failures in 45m window after throttling. embedding throughput lower but stable. thanks for quick help.
Maya (CSM): closing loop for now. leaving triage open for 48h. will share a short enablement note with recommended batching and retry patterns. :thumbsup:
